resolution.quote:
-        self.pub_tf = rospy.Publisher("/tf", TFMessage, queue_size=1)
+        self.pub_tf = rospy.Publisher("/tf", TFMessage, queue_size=100)

notes: Independently verified this session. (1) Eligibility: issue #89 (marbosjo, 2015-03-18, 'Successive sended transforms from a node not being received by tf2 python') read via API — the quoted defect text and the full tf2_timing_test reproducer (two TransformBroadcaster objects, Rate(5)) match; comments verified: tfoote id 83259331 verbatim (the spec's failed-condition quote, including markdown link text), mrath id 83945648 'Fixed with queue_size 100 in pull request #90.', tfoote id 84090881 'Fixed in #90'. Stop at 6 with interface kind topic is right: the same consumer works with the C++ broadcaster ('This bug does not happen in the tf2 cpp implementation neither in tf.' — verified in issue body), so the loss depends on the provider's publisher behavior on /tf, not one unit's internal logic; the fix changes the publisher declaration's queue depth (code, not deployment name-binding, build, or firmware). Modeling tf2_ros as provider and tf2_tools (view_frames) as consumer is documented and defensible; both package.xml read 0.5.8 at 1bbf9108 (verified). (2) Condition: class 'other' agrees — I verified at source that tf2_ros/src/tf2_ros/transform_broadcaster.py line 44 at 1bbf9108 reads 'self.pub_tf = rospy.Publisher("/tf", TFMessage, queue_size=1)' while tf2_ros/src/transform_broadcaster.cpp line 42 reads 'publisher_ = node_.advertise<tf2_msgs::TFMessage>("/tf", 100);' and transform_listener.py line 52 reads 'rospy.Subscriber("/tf", TFMessage, self.callback)'; the outgoing-queue-depth property has no dedicated schema class (ROS 1 queue_size is not one of the named QoS dimensions and rate_shortfall does not fit message loss), so 'other' with the explanatory note is correct. (3) Loudness silent_documented/run: loss observed only as missing frames in view_frames output, no diagnostic shown or expected (ROS 1 publisher drops silently when its outgoing queue is full). (4) Resolution recommended: PR #90 verified (title 'same queue size of transform boradcaster in c++ and Python', author mrath, base indigo-devel@1bbf9108, merged 2015-03-20T18:08:05Z); the actual merge commit is ede2646d with parents 1bbf9108 + 411d5c52 and the exact queue_size=1->100 diff (verified via gh api; the PR API's synthetic merge_commit_sha aa178852 differs but the two-parent merge commit confirms the spec's revision basis); no re-run of the reproducer against the merged revision is shown in the source, so recommended, not observed.
